title: The Ends Justify the Thoughts: RL-Induced Motivated Reasoning in LLM CoTs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's chain-of-thought using an LLM judge to detect motivated reasoning (a cognitive bias where the model generates plausible-sounding justifications to achieve a preferred outcome while downplaying conflicting constitutional instructions) across tasks like harmful request compliance, risk-taking, and delayed gratification.
